target.title: fix(llm): stop retrying permanent errors and long-window rate limits
target.body:
Closes #102250

## What Problem This Solves

The session auto-retry classifier (`isRetryableAssistantError`) treated a range of **permanent** provider errors as transient, so the outer retry loop re-sent the entire conversation up to `maxRetries` (default 3) before giving up. Each doomed retry re-bills full input/context tokens for a request that can never succeed — the exact cost bug reported in the issue.

Two root causes:

1. **Bare HTTP status tokens were matched as unanchored substrings.** The retryable denylist contained `"429"`, `"500"`, `"502"`, `"503"`, `"504"`. Because there were no word boundaries, any error message that merely *embedded* those digits classified as retryable:
   - `model gpt-5.5-preview-0429 not found` → `429` matched → a permanent **404** looked retryable
   - `Image dimensions 1504x1504 exceed the maximum allowed size` → `504` matched → a permanent **400** looked retryable
   - `invalid api key sk-proj-abc502xyz` → `502` matched → a permanent **401** looked retryable
2. **Long-window rate limits were retried in a short-backoff loop.** A daily or multi-hour rate limit (`Retry after 6h`, `try again in 24 hours`, `requests per day`) matched the retryable `rate limit` / `429` patterns, but the retry schedule is a handful of sub-15s exponential backoffs (2s / 4s / 8s). Those retries cannot possibly clear a window measured in hours — they just re-send context and re-bill.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **Anchor the status tokens on word boundaries** (`\b429\b`, `\b500\b`, `\b502\b`, `\b503\b`, `\b504\b`). A standalone status code (`429 Too Many Requests`, `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable`) still matches; a digit run inside a model id, image dimension, request id, or API key no longer does.
- **Classify long-window rate limits as non-retryable** by adding `per day`, `daily … limit`, and multi-hour/day "try again in N hours" / "retry after Nh" phrasings to the non-retryable pattern, which is checked first and short-circuits the retryable patterns.

The change is deliberately scoped to the classifier's pattern lists — the retry loop, backoff schedule, and `maxRetries` default are untouched. No new cross-module imports were added (the classifier stays in the `llm` layer), so there is no change to module boundaries.

## User Impact

Permanent errors (bad model id, invalid image dimensions, invalid API key, and other 4xx failures whose text embedded a status substring) now fail fast on the first response instead of being retried up to 3× with the full context re-sent each time. For a long session, that removes up to two extra full-context round-trips per permanent failure — directly reducing token spend and surfacing the real error to the user sooner. Long-window rate limits likewise stop being retried uselessly. Genuine transient failures (real 429/5xx, overload, timeouts, connection resets, short-window "please retry" guidance) retry exactly as before.

## Evidence

Old vs. new classifier over the issue's failing cases plus a genuine-transient guard set (`true` = retryable):

| Error message | old | new | expected |
|---|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| `model gpt-5.5-preview-0429 not found` (permanent 404) | ✅ retry | ⛔ no | ⛔ |
| `Image dimensions 1504x1504 exceed the maximum allowed size` (permanent 400) | ✅ retry | ⛔ no | ⛔ |
| `invalid api key sk-proj-abc502xyz` (permanent 401) | ✅ retry | ⛔ no | ⛔ |
| `429 … daily request limit. Please try again in 24 hours.` | ✅ retry | ⛔ no | ⛔ |
| `rate limit reached for requests. Retry after 6h.` | ✅ retry | ⛔ no | ⛔ |
| `429 Too Many Requests` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `500 Internal Server Error` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `Error 502 Bad Gateway` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `overloaded_error: the model is overloaded` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `socket hang up` / `fetch failed` / `request timed out` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `connection reset before headers were received` | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |
| `rate limit exceeded, please retry your request` (short-window) | ✅ retry | ✅ retry | ✅ |

**5 false-positive retries removed, 0 genuine-transient regressions.**

**Tests** — added to `src/llm/utils/retry.test.ts`: the three status-substring permanent errors → non-retryable, three long-window rate limits → non-retryable, and four standalone HTTP status codes → still retryable. Existing cases (explicit retry guidance, quota failures, short-window `requests per minute` exhaustion, transient billing-service failure) still pass. `pnpm test src/llm/utils/retry.test.ts` → 16 passed.
